entities.name: Gurn Keep
entities.description: Dwarf stronghold in the Crimson Peaks of Sarpadia, one of the last dwarven bastions to fall.

entities.name: Sarpadia
entities.description: Continent of Dominaria where the Crimson Peaks lie.

entities.name: Reod Dai
entities.description: Human who slipped into the besieged Gurn Keep looking for Tamun.

entities.name: Tamun
entities.description: Woman Reod Dai sought, reunited with him and her mother Melelki.

entities.name: Sekena
entities.description: Tamun's sister, who rescued them on her bonded dragon.

entities.name: Sarya Haasendel
entities.description: Captain who led the surviving dwarves into an abandoned mine after General Danhelm was slain.

entities.name: Ivra Jursdotter
entities.description: Mercenary sent south by the Order of the Ebon Hand, later seen among the orcs and goblins.

entities.name: Order of the Ebon Hand
entities.description: Order that alone answered Sarya's pleas for help.

events.summary: Reod Dai passes through the goblin army into Gurn Keep and helps organize its defenses before being imprisoned by the distrustful dwarves.
events.quote: After the siege had begun, Reod Dai passed through the goblin army and entered the keep, looking for Tamun .

events.summary: Sekena, mounted on her bonded dragon, saves Reod, Tamun and Melelki from the swarming goblins.
events.quote: The three of them were saved from the swarming goblins by Tamun's sister Sekena mounted on her bonded dragon .

events.summary: Surviving dwarves take refuge in an abandoned mine under Captain Sarya Haasendel after General Danhelm is slain.
events.quote: With the dwarven leader General Danhelm slain, the surviving dwarves took refuge in a nearby abandoned mine under the leadership of Captain Sarya Haasendel .

relations.note: Sent as a mercenary by the Order.
relations.quote: the Order of the Ebon Hand , who sent the mercenary Ivra Jursdotter to the south
